task: Write a team update with these seven constraints: (1) 720 to 720 words inclusive; a word is a match of [A-Za-z]+(?:'[A-Za-z]+)?, so punctuation is not a word. (6) Begin exactly "Dear team,". (7) End exactly "Kind regards.".
